limitations: R2 was amended after a metadata-triggered R1 failure; it is not an unchanged original Q14-E002 execution.
Only three subjects needed 128-to-160-Hz resampling; their subgroup is descriptive, not separately powered.
BNCI and PhysioNet acquisition/reference differ, so the external contrast does not identify one mechanism.
Binary external BA cannot be directly compared numerically with four-class Q5-Q9 results.
This independent validation ran on a different host/runtime from the frozen inference; both runtimes are recorded and are not represented as identical.

native_rate_sensitivity.role: descriptive sensitivity only; no alternate primary endpoint or model selection

q8_verified_review.inferential_role: Exploratory previously examined cohort; sign-test denominator discrepancy is documented, not concealed.

q13_verified_matched_runtime.selection_not_reoptimized: Historical Q5 source-only epoch schedule replayed under matched runtime; not fresh mean-loss reselection.

q13_verified_source_counts.inference_unit: 9 target participants after averaging four predefined source subsets and three seeds; neither source subsets nor seeds are independent participants. More source people also changes natural optimizer update exposure.

q14_verified_review.amendment: Three participants 88, 92, 100 had native 128 Hz and were resampled to 160 Hz following metadata-triggered failure after partial external execution; 87 previous participants retained byte-identical prediction evidence. Later portability validation was validation only, not new fitting or inference.

scope: Q1-Q14 only; Q15 independently reviewed in separate evidence.
